How to get it :
- [[Cyclotron|Cyclotron]] : [[gv:part_carbon|Box of Carbon Dust]], [[gv:powder_astatine|Astatine Powder]].
- [[Cyclotron|Cyclotron]] : [[gv:part_copper|Box of Copper Dust]], [[gv:powder_caesium|Caesium Powder]].
- Crafting table : 9 x [[gv:powder_actinium_tiny|Tiny Pile of Actinium Powder]].

Used to make :
[[gv:ingot_actinium|Actinium-227 Ingot]], [[gv:powder_actinium_tiny|Tiny Pile of Actinium Powder]].
